title: Invertibility of strict-henselization cohomology comparison
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism f, geometric point xbar, abelian etale sheaf F and q : ℕ, the canonical strict-henselization cohomology comparison is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Display the original four-factor canonical cohomology comparison on the small coordinate-ring-colimit spectrum explicitly, replacing the retired specialized Leray definition by exactGlobalSectionsLerayHomologyIso applied to strictHenselizationScheme_globalSections_preservesFiniteColimits. This replacement is definitionally equal to the original composite. The first, third and fourth factors are functor images or components of isomorphisms. For the second factor, the private generic mappedMate equality and equality induction on its square reduce to strict-local global homology base change for F[0]. Compose the four IsIso proofs. No scheme model, morphism or hypothesis is changed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03Q9, theorem-higher-direct-images and remark-stalk-fibre; the same four-factor canonical comparison using the generic exact-sections Leray API after retirement of its specialized definition
